params.caption:
📉 NVIDIA reportedly plans ANOTHER cut to GeForce RTX 50-series gaming GPU supply.

A claim surfacing on the Chinese forum Board Channels — picked up by VideoCardz and TweakTown — says NVIDIA will cut GeForce RTX 50-series allocations to board partners by a further 20-30% for the November 2026-January 2027 quarter, on top of shipment restrictions already reported in China earlier this year. If accurate, it would deepen the ongoing RTX 50-series supply crunch heading into 2027.

⚠️ Unconfirmed: this is a forum leak, not an NVIDIA statement. NVIDIA has not commented, and TweakTown's own report says to treat the 20-30% figure with skepticism.

🕓 Published: 03:57 GMT+3, Nov 26, 2026

📰 Sources: TweakTown, VideoCardz

👥 Follow: https://x.com/nvidia, https://x.com/VideoCardz

💬 Still hunting for an RTX 50-series card? Tell us in the comments 👇
